title: DOS-UAP-D002, Diplomatic Cable, Brazil, November 20, 1963
doc_notes: This document is a U.S. Department of State diplomatic cable from the U.S. Embassy in Rio de Janeiro reporting that a widely publicized UFO crash in Bahia was a fabrication.

incidents.summary: Alleged crash of an unidentified object in Conde, Bahia, Brazil, which was investigated and determined to be a fabrication.
incidents.explanation: The incident was determined to be a fabrication originating in Rio de Janeiro; local authorities and the Ministry of Aeronautics found no evidence of any object.
incidents.quote: Story of strange object descending in region of Conde Bahia apparently fabricated in Rio
